title: 第五章 马镫
slug: 重生之战神吕布全本免费-重生之战神吕布最新章节列表
content_zh:
“将军何出此言？”曹性疑问道。
“哼，那董卓在雒阳城内倒行逆施，早已是惹得天怒人怨，当初欲要废掉当今圣上，丁刺史一力阻拦，不想为其所害；但他小觑了天下英雄，只待一道檄文，董卓便会成为诸侯讨伐的对象，以一己之力对抗天下，岂有胜利之理。”吕布自然是知道这段历史，信口说道。
“将军英明。”曹性附和道。
“少拍马屁，好好训练，别以为你是虎卫统领就能搞特殊，虎卫若是不合格，你就给虎卫喂马去。”
“将军放心，卑职这点本事还是有的。”曹性嘿嘿笑道，将领之中，也就他敢在吕布面前如此，这还是经过最近的观察，他发现吕布的脾气变得好了很多，开一些玩笑什么的也多了起来。
“滚。”吕布佯怒道。
“我这就滚，这就滚。”曹性嬉皮笑脸的说道。
吕布感觉心中一暖，似乎找到了前世在军队中的感觉，相比之下，并州军中更多的是服从，少了战友情谊，看来以后有时间要改变一下了，让军中的士兵找到归属感，更利于提升战斗力。
各部将领在忙着练兵，吕布更是不能闲着，为了更快的适应战马，数日以来，没少从马上掉下来，在军中各将领面前也是闹了不少的笑话。
经过一番观察，吕布发现汉代的战马的确是少了点东西，怪不得总是从马上掉下来呢，马镫，是战马不可或缺的东西，有了他，上下马变得容易，在战马上做出各种动作也不会担心掉下来。
于是吕布命人悄悄打造了马镫，才保证了在战马上自如的活动，不得不说吕布的这副身躯不愧是三国第一猛将，力气没的说，记忆中的戟法也是惊天地泣鬼神，只要自己熟练运用之后，天下有谁是敌手，除了这骑术需要加强一下。
随后，吕布又为所有的战马装上了马镫，有了这件划时代的宝物，骑兵的战斗力上涨了一倍，原本只能在马背上做一些简单动作的骑兵。
有了马镫之后能够做出一些高难度的动作来，普通骑兵有了一般将领的骑术，放在战场上绝对是碾压性的存在，骑在有马镫的战马上，吕布也感觉十分舒坦，不用时刻担心会掉下战马。
骑兵发现了马镫的用处之后也是十分兴奋，心想着下次遇到西凉军，让他们看看什么叫做骑术。
是夜，吕布带领曹性的一千虎卫，悄悄的开始了夜间演练。
隆隆的马蹄声响彻四野，经过数场战斗的并州军哪能不明白这是有骑兵来了。
“敌袭！”巡逻的士兵大喊一声，不停的敲着手中的铜锣。
许多士兵刚刚睡下，喧闹的声音将他们从梦想拽了回来，手忙脚乱的穿上衣服，惊慌之下却是忘记了兵器放在了什么地方。
看着慌乱不堪的大营和盲目指挥的各部将领，甚至还有一些士兵将刀枪指向了自家兵马，吕布眉头直皱。
“点火！”吕布冷声道。

火光的照耀下，慌乱的士兵看到是自家兵马，长舒了一口气，成廉脸色铁青的看着衣衫不整的部下，迈步向吕布走去。
“看看你们都像什么样子，就这样还想着为刺史大人报仇？就你们这样，如果真是西凉军杀来了，有几个能活着的？”营帐内，吕布厉声道：“难道当晚的教训你们都忘了？”
“成廉将军，你平时就是这么训练士卒的，敌人来袭，赤手空拳上阵。”
“启禀将军，卑职训练不力，请将军责罚。”成廉脸色通红。
“哼，第一次就算了，如果下次再让我看到有一名士兵没有拿兵器，你就亲自去将兵器给他取来，有谁没穿好衣服，你就帮他穿。”
“诺。”成廉拱手道，心中则是想着回去之后怎么训练那些部下。
帐内其他将领心中一惊，看来以后要加强夜间的训练了，不然也来上这么一出，丢人不说，说不定还会丢官。
“以后夜间休息，将领要清楚自己手下将士的位置，一旦有变，能够及时组织兵马，夜间巡逻的士兵，要提高警惕，一律使用口令，如果再让我发现你们面对敌人突袭是这副模样，都给我滚到草原上喂马去。”
吕布亲自带军偷营之后，各部兵马夜间休息的时候谨慎了很多，面对后来两次的偷营，也能有条不紊的组织抵抗，虽然仍旧有些慌乱，却不是那么手足无措。

content_en:
"Why did the general say this?" Cao Xing asked.
"Hmph, Dong Zhuo's rebellious behavior in Luoyang City has already made people angry. When he wanted to depose the current emperor, Governor Ding tried his best to stop him and did not want to harm him; but he underestimated the heroes of the world. With just one message, Dong Zhuo would become the target of the princes' crusade. There is no reason to win against the world with his own power." Lu Bu naturally knew this history and said freely.
"The general is wise." Cao Xing agreed.
"Stop flattering and train hard. Don't think that just because you are the leader of the Tiger Guard, you can do something special. If the Tiger Guard is unqualified, just feed the Tiger Guard."
"Don't worry, general, I still have the ability to humble myself." Cao Xing chuckled. Among the generals, he was the only one who dared to do this in front of Lu Bu. This was after recent observation. He found that Lu Bu's temper had become much better and he made more jokes.
"Go away." Lu Bu said in feigned anger.
"I'm going to get out of here, I'm going to get out of here." Cao Xing said with a playful smile.
Lu Bu felt warm in his heart, and seemed to have found the feeling of being in the army in his previous life. In contrast, the Bingzhou Army was more about obedience and less about comradeship. It seems that there will be time to change it in the future, so that the soldiers in the army can find a sense of belonging, which will be more conducive to improving combat effectiveness.
The generals were busy training troops, and Lu Bu couldn't be idle. In order to adapt to the war horse faster, he fell off the horse many times in the past few days, and made a lot of jokes in front of the generals in the army.
After some observation, Lu Bu discovered that the war horses of the Han Dynasty were indeed missing something. No wonder they kept falling off the horses. Stirrups were an indispensable thing for war horses. With them, it became easier to get on and off the horse, and you could make various movements on the war horse without worrying about falling off.
So Lu Bu ordered people to quietly build stirrups, which ensured the freedom of movement on the war horse. I have to say that Lu Bu's body is worthy of being the most powerful general in the Three Kingdoms. Even if he is not strong enough, the halberd technique in his memory is also shocking. As long as he is proficient in using it, there is no one in the world who can rival him. Except for his riding skills, which need to be strengthened.
Later, Lu Bu installed stirrups on all the horses. With this epoch-making treasure, the combat effectiveness of the cavalry doubled. The cavalry could only do some simple movements on horseback.
With stirrups, they can perform some difficult movements. Ordinary cavalry have the riding skills of ordinary generals. They are absolutely crushing on the battlefield. Lu Bu also feels very comfortable riding on a horse with stirrups. He does not have to worry about falling off the horse at all times.
The cavalrymen were very excited after discovering the use of stirrups. They thought that next time they met the Xiliang army, they could show them what riding skills were.
That night, Lu Bu led Cao Xing's thousand tiger guards and quietly began a night drill.
The rumble of horse hooves resounded throughout the fields. How could the Bingzhou Army, which had gone through several battles, not understand that cavalry was coming.
"Enemy attack!" the patrolling soldier shouted and kept banging the gong in his hand.
Many soldiers had just fallen asleep, and the noisy sound pulled them back from their dreams. They hurriedly put on their clothes, but in their panic, they forgot where their weapons were.
Looking at the panicked camp and the generals who were commanding blindly, and some soldiers even pointing their swords and guns at their own troops, Lu Bu frowned.
"Light the fire!" Lu Bu said coldly.
Under the light of the fire, the panicked soldiers breathed a sigh of relief when they saw that it was their own soldiers and horses. Cheng Lian looked at the disheveled subordinates with a livid face and walked towards Lu Bu.
"Look at what you all look like. Are you still thinking about avenging the governor? If you are like this, if the Xiliang army really comes to kill you, how many of you will be alive?" In the camp, Lu Bu said sharply: "Have you forgotten the lesson learned that night?"
"General Cheng Lian, this is how you usually train your soldiers. When the enemy attacks, go into battle with bare hands."
"Report to General,If you are poorly trained for your humble position, please ask the general to punish you. "Cheng Lian's face turned red.
"Huh, forget it the first time. If I see a soldier without a weapon next time, you will go and get the weapon for him personally. If anyone is not dressed, you will help him put it on. "
"No. " Cheng Lian cupped his hands and thought about how to train his subordinates after returning.
The other generals in the tent were shocked. It seemed that they would have to strengthen night training in the future. Otherwise, if they did something like this, it would be embarrassing and they might even lose their official positions.
"From now on, when resting at night, generals must know the positions of their soldiers. If there is a change, they can organize their troops and horses in time. Soldiers patrolling at night must be more vigilant and use passwords. If I find you like this again when facing an enemy surprise attack, get off to the grassland and feed your horses." "
After Lu Bu personally led the troops to steal the camp, the troops became much more cautious when resting at night. Facing the two subsequent stolen camps, they were able to organize resistance in an orderly manner. Although they were still a little panicked, they were not so at a loss.
